mapper.select: select id, parent_id, name, type, permission_code, path, sort, create_time, update_time from menu order by parent_id, sort, id

select distinct m.permission_code from menu m join role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id join employee_role er on rm.role_id = er.role_id where er.employee_id = #{employeeId} and m.permission_code is not null order by m.permission_code

select distinct m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.type, m.permission_code, m.path, m.sort from menu m join role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id join employee_role er on rm.role_id = er.role_id where er.employee_id = #{employeeId} and m.type = 1 order by m.parent_id, m.sort, m.id
